source: M/M/1 mean wait E(W) = (rho/mu)/(1 - rho), rho = 0.75, 1/mu = 90 s: 270 s; Adan and Resing, Queueing Systems (2015), section 4.3
M/M/1 mean queue length E(Lq) = rho^2/(1 - rho), rho = 0.75: 2.25; Adan and Resing, Queueing Systems (2015), section 4.3
M/M/1 mean sojourn time E(S) = (1/mu)/(1 - rho) = 90 s / 0.25 = 360 s; Adan and Resing, Queueing Systems (2015), section 4.3
A stable queue with no loss passes its arrival rate: lambda = 1/120 per second (30 per hour)
